source: Recorded with tee-cli.ts in front of Grok 1.0.70 by a bare ACP client in a throwaway git folder, default mode (the ACP backend has no `steerTurn` to send it). A prompt runs `sleep 15`; 2 s into the running tool the client sends `_x.ai/interject` `{ sessionId, text }`. Grok answers `{ status: "queued" }` at once and sends `_x.ai/session/interjection` with the text; the tool runs its full 15 s with no `session/cancel`, the model follows the message in the same turn, and the one `session/prompt` response ends it with `end_turn`. Hook, MCP, announcement, model, setup and summary frames and tool argument chunks are left out; message chunks stay. `t` is milliseconds from the start, `dir` is `in` for what went to Grok.
